facts.fact: Built1562–1563, university seat until1803; courtyard and coats of arms. Building access differs from mandatory booked tourist-room visits; library not open for tourism. Piazza Galvani entrance, alternate via de’ Foscherari2 with lift; room availability subject to institutional use.
facts.excerpt: The Library area is not accessible to tourists
